inputs.original_text:
Open your eyes, people, because what they are selling us as a normal political disagreement is nothing more than a carefully scripted theatrical diversion. They want you focused on the surface so you miss the real puppet masters pulling the strings behind the scenes. 

Look at the blatant stagecraft happening in plain sight: Angus Taylor has shut down Andrew Hastie’s push for the Liberals to be “open-minded” to increasing taxes on gas companies and winding back concessions for property investors. This isn't a mere clash of philosophies at all—it is a managed illusion of debate designed to keep the untouched elite consensus completely secure. 

And notice what else is being meticulously controlled here. The opposition leader also did not repeat Hastie’s criticism of Donald Trump as he refused to say whether or not he endorsed the US and Israel’s war with Iran. Why the sudden, coordinated silence? Because they are all taking orders from the exact same hidden global network, toeing the line on foreign conflicts while pretending to squabble over domestic tax policy. Do not fall for their official narrative.
